taxon.wikipedia_summary: Chaenorhinum origanifolium is a species of flowering plant in the Plantaginaceae family. It is native to mountainous regions of the Iberian Peninsula and the Balearic Islands. It grows on rocks and crevices of escarpments, usually in limestone cliffs.
